notes: «وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» has no transmitter and the Imam is unnamed: the Imam is inherited from prev1, the one it names as answerer («أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»)
«وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» has no transmitter and the Imam is unnamed: the Imam is inherited from prev1, the one it names as answerer («أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ»)
«وَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ» names no speaker: the Imam is taken over from report 1496 (prev1), which names him as the one Abu Basir asked. The Imam is the last link.
